response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating), above AS (SELECT p.avg_per_day FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_per_day > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(a.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_above, AVG(a.avg_per_day - o.overall_avg) AS avg_gap_above FROM above a CROSS JOIN overall o;
